mutants.title: a stable binding writes cancel instead of go, so a retirement the caller authorised never happens
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: the record is no longer compared with what the caller authorised, so a committed re-arm after ready still gets go
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: the receiver's native session is not joined to the record, so a marker re-armed for another session still gets go
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: the sender marker's garden is not compared, so an owner that switched to another citizen in place is still terminated
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: an unbound record is not refused by name, so a record no arm ever touched reaches the binding comparison as if it had one
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: a missing packaged helper is not refused, so the interpreter is started on a path that is not the helper
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: the helper entry is followed through a symlink, so a file that is not the packaged bytes can stand in for the helper
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: a ready line naming another pid is accepted, so the helper's process and the binding the adapter checked need not be the same
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: every stdout chunk forgets the protocol failure an earlier chunk recorded, so a buffered ready behind a bad line is parsed on the next chunk and gets go
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: a go whose write threw leaves no trace, so the unknown outcome no longer names why it is unknown
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: incomplete trailing stdout is ignored, so a valid exited line followed by junk is reported as an observed exit
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: terminal lines are no longer closed to the helper's wire shape, so extra or contradicting keys pass as a known outcome
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: the receiver owner kind is not checked, so another harness's process holding a matching marker is treated as a Claude Code owner
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: the requester's AbortSignal is dropped from the helper exchange, so neither the abort listener nor the ready-time abort check can stop a go while the fd is held (the preflight abort checks before spawn are untouched)
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts

mutants.title: an abort after go is not recorded, so its ending is reported as a generic protocol failure instead of the requester's abort
mutants.subject: pi-extensions/lib/cc-retire-request.ts
